title: Basic Properties of Matter and Earth Systems (Day 137)
description: Observing the physical differences between solids, liquids, and atmospheric gases.
concept: Matter changes visible shapes while retaining its underlying physical mass.
bullets: Solids maintain a fixed structure and do not deform to fit containers.
Liquids flow dynamically to fill bottom boundaries of open space.
Gases expand infinitely to fill all available volumetric areas.
cross_reference: Genesis 1:7 — And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament.
